messages.subject: R-GSOC'25 application
messages.body_plain:
Hi all
Google recently posted their timeline for GSOC'25
https://developers.google.com/open-source/gsoc/timeline?hl=fr
I plan to submit an application for R project again this year.
Looking forward to another R-GSOC!
Best
Toby Hocking

messages.body_plain:
Awesome, Toby!

If accepted, perhaps we should organize a global meetup / user group kickoff event to promote this?

I’m happy to lead organize this and work with anyone on the thread interested in discussing their projects.
